items.source: Labels not defined through the class hierarchy or the list of dynamic labels will be removed from the database when @DynamicLabels is used.
items.translation: 通过类层次结构或动态标签列表未定义的标签，在使用了@DynamicLabels时将从数据库中移除。

items.source: This annotation can be used on a field of type Collection<String>. The content of this field will be treated as dynamic or runtime managed labels. This means: All labels that are not statically defined via the class hierarchy and the corresponding @Node annotation are added to this list while loading the entity and all values contained in the collection will be added to the nodes labels.
items.translation: 此注解可应用于类型为 Collection<String> 的字段。该字段的值将被视为动态或运行时管理的标签。这意味着：所有未通过类层次结构及相应的 @Node 注解静态定义的标签，将在加载实体时添加到此列表中，且集合中包含的所有值都将被添加为节点的标签。
